result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a residential street with continuous sidewalks and a high-visibility continental crosswalk at the intersection. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and stop signs are present, parked vehicles near the crossing create sightline obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the side street obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While stop signs and curb ramps are present, pedestrian visibility is compromised by vehicles parked close to the crossing and mature street trees.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk create a 'daylighting' issue, obstructing sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street leading up to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Vegetation Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large, low-hanging tree on the right side of the street may partially obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, overhanging the sidewalk and roadway near the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian prominence.

result.summary: A residential intersection featuring a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides of the street. The environment is generally pedestrian-friendly but lacks traffic control signals and suffers from reduced visibility due to parked cars near the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are located very close to the crosswalk, which can hide pedestrians (especially children) from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street leading up to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with a marked continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. The environment is relatively calm with mature trees, but sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The white paint of the continental crosswalk is showing signs of wear and cracking, reducing its visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to ensure it is clearly seen by approaching motorists.
